news.api.serializers

Serializers for converting application models to API representations.

Serializers define exposed fields and validate relationships submitted to the REST API.

Classes

ApprovedArticleLogSerializer

Expose an approval log entry.

ArticleSerializer

Read and write articles.

NewsletterSerializer

Read and write newsletters; the author is the requesting user.

PublisherSerializer

Expose a publisher with the IDs of its editors and journalists.

UserSerializer

Expose a user's ID, username, and role.

Details

class news.api.serializers.UserSerializer(*args, **kwargs)[source]

Bases: ModelSerializer

Expose a user’s ID, username, and role.

The email address is only included when a user views their own record, so signed-in users cannot collect other users’ addresses.

to_representation(instance)[source]

Return the user’s data, without email unless it is their own.

Parameters:

instance (news.models.User) – The user being serialized.

Returns:

The serialized user.

Return type:

dict

class news.api.serializers.PublisherSerializer(*args, **kwargs)[source]

Bases: ModelSerializer

Expose a publisher with the IDs of its editors and journalists.

class news.api.serializers.ArticleSerializer(*args, **kwargs)[source]

Bases: ModelSerializer

Read and write articles.

The author and approval status are read-only: the author is set from the requesting journalist, and new articles always start unapproved.

validate(attrs)[source]

Check that a journalist choosing a publisher is affiliated with it.

The check runs when a journalist creates (POST) or updates (PUT/PATCH) an article.

Raises:

rest_framework.serializers.ValidationError – If the requesting journalist is not one of the publisher’s journalists.

create(validated_data)[source]

Create an unapproved article owned by the journalist or publisher.

Returns:

The saved article.

Return type:

news.models.Article

update(instance, validated_data)[source]

Update an article and keep exactly one owner.

As in create(), an article with a publisher has no author. When a journalist removes the publisher, they become the author.

Returns:

The saved article.

Return type:

news.models.Article
